theme: An open Sunday with a few travel windows closing.
greeting: Morning, Dan. One short review with Mike at nine, then the day is yours — the only real pressure is a cluster of travel bookings whose windows are closing this week.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 task to book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has been open since Sept 14. It's the hardest rental in that market over the holidays and sells out — a refundable hold now costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by was Sept 30 and book-by is Oct 15 — four days out, for six people over three weeks. Passports won't be in hand at booking, so a domestic shortlist is the safe default unless you want refundable international.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Portland to St Pete drive window is open now and closes Oct 18. Once the dates are set, booking the single hotel night locks the whole plan in.
